ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across the central 80% of the fluke, with high-intensity white pixel clusters isolated to the distal 10% of each lobe extremity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left distal lobe: Contiguous white pigmentation block from edge to interior with internal black punctate flecks. Right distal lobe: Diffuse white mottling with five distinct dark linear streaks extending vertically from the inferior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep bounding-box recession relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable high-amplitude irregular indentation (approx. 20 pixels deep) located mid-length on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex proximal edges transitioning to a slight concavity just before reaching the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of raised, textured, circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme dorsal-lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the lower-left central portion of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch or traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately equidistant between the median notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical dark pigmentation 'finger' patterns isolated within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe tip.
